compiled_state.description:
## Problem

The scheduled **Test Suite (mirror)** workflow (`.github/workflows/test.yml`) has been red on **every** run for 12+ consecutive scheduled runs (through 2026-08-29). Unlike the tolerated legs, the red is driven by legs that are **NOT** `continue-on-error` and represent **supported** configurations:

- `sweep (macos, full suite)` — macOS + Python 3.13 (installs `uv pip install '.[dev,reviewbot,ui]'`, **non-editable**)
- `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` — Ubuntu + Python 3.11, `--resolution lowest-direct` (**non-editable**)

(The `sweep (windows)` leg is `continue-on-error: true`, and the pre-release interpreter cells — 3.14t/3.15 — are `continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental }}`; those legs' failures, e.g. Windows `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fcntl'`, are EXPECTED and do not gate. The two legs above are the genuine signal.)

## Decisive evidence (run 33253319934, sha `5fb693345b0c`)

`sweep (macos, full suite)` fails at **collection**:
```
ERROR collecting tests/unit/test_release_guards.py
E   FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory:
    '/Users/runner/work/rebar/rebar/.venv/lib/python3.13/scripts/release_guards.py'
ERROR at setup of test_wheel_from_sdist_bakes_env_commit
E   FileNotFoundError: ... '/Users/runner/work/rebar/rebar/.venv/lib/python3.13/hatch_build.py'
```
`sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` fails the same way, plus a floor-specific packaging error:
```
FileNotFoundError: ... '/home/runner/work/rebar/rebar/.venv/lib/python3.11/scripts/release_guards.py'
TypeError: Field `project.license-files` must be a table
  .venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/hatchling/metadata/core.py:725: TypeError
```

## Root cause

`tests/unit/test_release_guards.py:31` computes the repo root from the installed package:
```python
ROOT = Path(rebar.__file__).resolve().parents[2]
_SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts" / "release_guards.py"
```
Under an **editable** install (the primary Gerrit Verified Gate / `test.yml` critical path uses `uv sync`/editable), `rebar.__file__` is `src/rebar/__init__.py`, so `parents[2]` is the repo root and `scripts/release_guards.py` exists.

Under the sweep's **non-editable** install (`uv pip install '.'`), `rebar.__file__` is `<venv>/lib/pythonX/site-packages/rebar/__init__.py`, so `parents[2]` resolves to `<venv>/lib/pythonX/` and `_SCRIPT` becomes `<venv>/lib/pythonX/scripts/release_guards.py` — which is not packaged, hence `FileNotFoundError`. The same editable-layout coupling breaks the packaging tests that reach for the repo-root `hatch_build.py`. These tests are only exercised in the breadth sweep (the critical path runs a `platform_compat` subset), so the defect is invisible on the merge gate.

The lower-bound `TypeError: Field project.license-files must be a table` is a second, distinct floor issue: the declared minimum `hatchling` predates the current `[project].license-files` string/array form in `pyproject.toml`, so the wheel/sdist build fixtures cannot build at the floor.

## Impact

The scheduled breadth sweep is chronically red, so it can no longer surface a NEW macOS-only or lower-bound regression — its signal is buried. Per test.yml a red sweep "gates no merge," but these are real test-portability defects on supported platforms that should be green.

## The fix (candidates)

- Make the release/packaging tests locate the repo root independently of the install layout (e.g. skip when `scripts/release_guards.py` / `hatch_build.py` are absent because rebar is installed non-editable, or resolve ROOT via a repo marker rather than `Path(rebar.__file__).parents[2]`), so they self-skip or pass under a non-editable install.
- Raise the declared `hatchling` floor to a version that accepts the current `[project].license-files` form (or adjust the license-files declaration to satisfy the floor), so the lower-bound resolution can build the wheel/sdist.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sweep (macos, full suite)` collects and runs `tests/unit/test_release_guards.py` and the sdist/wheel packaging tests without `FileNotFoundError` under a non-editable install.
- [ ] `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` no longer raises `TypeError: Field project.license-files must be a table` at the declared floor.
- [ ] A `Test Suite (mirror)` scheduled run is green on the non-`continue-on-error` legs (Windows + experimental interpreter legs may remain tolerated).

## Evidence
- Failing run: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33253319934 (sha `5fb693345b0c`)
- Earlier same failure: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33239351184
- Chronic: `Test Suite (mirror)` has been `failure` on every scheduled run back to at least 2026-08-27.
- Sweep install steps: `.github/workflows/test.yml` `sweep-macos-full` (`uv pip install '.[dev,reviewbot,ui]'`) and `sweep-lower-bounds` (`uv pip install --resolution lowest-direct '.[dev,agents]'`).
compiled_state.title: Test Suite (mirror) sweep red on supported legs: release-packaging tests assume an editable/repo-relative layout and fail under the sweep's non-editable install
